name: MORI
author: L'Cronx
summary: A love letter to MEMENTO | Enjoy-Lab, with its own circuitry programmed by logic. A tempo-synced DUB loop you can record into, a stereo tempo delay, a multi-head and grain TEXTURE memory, reverb with shimmer, a bipolar filter and master FX, joined by a 14-way routing matrix. Five pages. MPC OS 3.x.
